items.title: One Device. Six Air Quality Sensors. Endless Possibilities.
items.description: In this video, I take a look at Air Lab. A portable, open-source air quality monitor built around an ESP32 with an e-paper display. It monitors CO₂, particulate matter (PM1/PM2.5/PM10), VOCs, NOx, temperature, humidity, pressure, and more, while performing on-device air quality analysis. It also integrates with Home Assistant using MQTT, making it a great fit for smart home enthusiasts. items.title: Visualize your ENTIRE network, including ZigBee with this tool!
items.description: Use Homelable to scan your network and identify all your servers, PCs, IoT devices, Zigbee devices, and more. This visualization tool can also monitor your network via multiple protocols and health checks and provide a quick view of what is up or down. With nmap enabled, manufacturer information can be identified via MAC address. Homelable can be run stand alone or as a HACS integration (which is what this video shows). items.title: The EASIEST way to set up presence zones for your mmWave sensors.
items.description: Zone Mapper allows you to track targets from any ld2450 or other coordinate reporting entities. The integration and card together allow you to create as many detection zones as you want, in any shape you want. Zone Mapper creates binary sensor entities that you can use in automations. SUPER SIMPLE! items.title: Monitor a wide area for water leaks with this Shelly Flood Gen4 sensor.
